seo.pirateDescription: All seventeen departments of NO Anchor University, from Mining (aboard since 1717) to Mathematics & Computing (still checking the navigator’s sums). A hackathon parody of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

original.title: Departments
original.lede: The University comprises seventeen academic departments.

pirate.title: The Crews
pirate.lede: Seventeen departments, each quietly certain the ship would sink without them. They are all correct.

pirate.heading: Find your crew
pirate.tagline: Filter by what they mostly do, or by how dusty their boots get.

cards.name: Applied Geology
cards.text: The original crew. Collects rocks, labels them and refuses to throw any away.

cards.name: Applied Geophysics
cards.text: Listens to the ground with very expensive instruments. Sometimes the ground answers.

cards.name: Chemical Engineering
cards.text: Turns small reactions in a flask into very large plants.

cards.name: Chemistry and Chemical Biology
cards.text: Knows what everything on board is made of, and which things should never be mixed.

cards.name: Civil Engineering
cards.text: Builds things that stay exactly where they are put. A bold idea on a ship with no anchor.

cards.name: Computer Science and Engineering
cards.text: Keeps the ship’s computers running, and is fairly sure the bug is in your code.

cards.name: Electrical Engineering
cards.text: Keeps the lights on, below deck and across the national grid.

cards.name: Electronics Engineering
cards.text: Makes very small things that do very clever jobs.

cards.name: Environmental Science and Engineering
cards.text: Makes sure the treasure hunt does not wreck the island.

cards.name: Fuel, Minerals and Metallurgical Engineering
cards.text: Takes what the miners dig up and turns it into something useful.

cards.name: Humanities and Social Sciences
cards.text: Asks why we are on this voyage at all. Usefully, and with footnotes.

cards.name: Management Studies and Industrial Engineering
cards.text: Works out who does what, by when, and what it will cost.

cards.name: Mathematics & Computing
cards.text: Does the sums the navigator keeps getting wrong.

cards.name: Mechanical Engineering
cards.text: Keeps everything that is supposed to turn, turning.

cards.name: Mining Engineering
cards.text: Digging since 1717. The reason this ship exists.

cards.name: Petroleum Engineering
cards.text: Knows where the oil is, and is far too polite to say how.

cards.name: Physics
cards.text: Explains why the ship floats. We have asked them to stop explaining why it might not.
